verdict.rationale: Quo ships end-user apps on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Web, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out control. The pack covers only API, MCP, pricing and feature material.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
